attempts.summary: Deployed HAProxy on node1 (OPNsense) with a frontend bound to its management address 10.100.122.10:80 that round-robins to backend HTTP servers on node2 and node3 (Python http.server on port 8080, each identifying its own hostname/IP). Verified node4 receives alternating responses from both backends through this single entry point, both before and after sequentially restarting all four nodes with independent boot-identity proof and post-restart recovery verification.
